# `code.blame.get`

Blame a file at a revision

Line hunks with introducing commits. Binary files fail.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/blame/{rev}/{path...}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code blame get`
- MCP: `code_blame_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

| `cursor` | query | no | `string` |
| `end_line` | query | no | `integer` |
| `limit` | query | no | `integer` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `path` | path | yes | `string` |
